author: OPTOBAT
body:
Hey everyone, i was playing a game of Nexus a while back and we were absolutely flogging, we were just pummelling the other team, and by the end the final score was something like 113 - 27!

Ahahaaa anyways i thought i could make a post where you say the highest Nexus score you've ever seen or been a part of and if you can please try to show a photo, but otherwise just be honest :)

Im not sure this post will work due to dishonesty and lack of Nexus gameplay but its worth a shot :)

SO, i was thinking of putting it in a top 10 list as the scores come along, so please comment/post your highest Nexus team score below :)

Top Ten Nexus Scores:

1. 298 Points!
2. 172 Points
3. 155 Points
4. 135 Points
5. 135 Points
6. 113 points
7. 108 Points
8. 92 Points 
9. 75 Points
10. 62 Points

In order for this to work you need to be honest! Please!
